title: Tsup Library Generator
description: Create a new TypeScript library configured with Tsup bundler

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use?

directory.description: Directory where the library will be created (defaults to packages)

testRunner.description: Test runner to use for the library
When omitted, this will be auto-detected from the root package.json. If ambiguous or not found, jest is used by default.

linter.description: Linter to use for the library
When omitted, this will be auto-detected from the root package.json. If ambiguous or not found, eslint is used by default.

formatter.description: Code formatter to use for the library
Code formatter. When omitted, this will be auto-detected. Biome formats and lints. ESLint Stylistic requires eslint as linter. If biome is selected as linter, formatter defaults to biome.
